quest.title: Flighty Flora... and Flora
quest.description: Flora from the flower shop in Mondstadt is quite upset... It seems that many of her flowers have suddenly been blown away by the wind. She's looking for somebody who could help her...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Hero's Wit x5, Cecilia x5, Small Lamp Grass x5, Windwheel Aster x5

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your flower shop...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About those flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Did you finish getting the flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got 'em right here.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: These are all so fresh... Thank you. With these flowers out at the storefront, we're sure to attract a lot of customers.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: If I could make another small request... the wind also blew all the dandelions we had away.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Although dandelions being carried away by the wind isn't a bad thing...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: But it still seem strange for a florist's in Mondstadt to not have dandelions.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Dandelions can't just be plucked and brought back — they have to be regrown from scratch.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: So could you help fetch a batch of Dandelion Seeds for me?

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: I'm counting on you, then. I recall that there are lots of dandelions just outside Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: There are lots of dandelions outside the city. You should be able to get them easily.

talks.objective: Collect one portion of Dandelion Seeds

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about those dandelions...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Have you managed to get the dandelions?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have them.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Thank you. This should be enough. I'll sow the seeds into these pots...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: ...Along with those flowers that you found for me earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. I have to thank you, don't I? This is a little token, please take it.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Now, I have to quickly put these flowers inside these pots here. Then the dandelions seeds go there...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Oh, right. The Dandelion Seeds have only just been sown, so there's nothing in the pot... I guess I'll have to take them off display for the time being.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Ah, I really hope they grow up soon...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About those flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: You can find small lamp grass and sweet flowers in the Whispering Woods. Windrise is where you'll find windwheel asters, and you can find cecilias on Starsnatch Cliff.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: You can definitely get the freshest flowers from these areas.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Once you've finished picking them, please bring them back to me as quickly as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about those dandelions...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Dandelions can be found just outside Mondstadt, but I have to clean up the shop, and simply don't have time to leave...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: So please, help me gather a batch of Dandelion Seeds.
